name: consumer-config-layout-shim
title: Consumer-config layout shim: zero pack-path literals
description: Install the layout resolver a second time at a consumer-config path (.sd-ai-command-pack/bin/) so consumer references to the pack survive thin conversion. Measured across the eight saved resweeps: 288 blockers in 68 files name a scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-* path, so a bootstrap probe would leave up to 68 blockers where a kept path leaves 0. Does not reach the 101 glob and fixture blockers.
